description: A narrow shopfront wedged between the modular housing stacks, its window crammed with the honest clutter of a repair trade — dead radios, a wall of salvaged hand tools, a hand-lettered card reading FIX-IT: IF IT RAN ONCE, IT'LL RUN AGAIN. No screens, no terminals, nothing that talks back to the grid. A bell hangs over the door. It smells of solder and machine oil.
name: Halloran's Fix-It
